full_judgment: 2. Short facts leading to this Rule are that on 17-7-1997 the opposite parties as plaintiffs instituted Other Suit No. 96 of 1997 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Third Court, Chittagong impleading the petitioners as defendants for recovery of khas possession by evicting the defendants from the suit land declaring them as their (plaintiffs) permissive possessor and also for declaration that the BS Khatian relating to suit land is illegal, incorrect, void, inoperative and not binding upon them.
